package.description: JSONPath-inspired query language for JSON, YAML, TOML, and other serialization formats

en-US.description: JSONPath-inspired query language for JSON, YAML, TOML, and other serialization formats
en-US.longDescription:
jsongrep is a command-line tool providing a JSONPath-inspired query language
for searching and filtering JSON, YAML, TOML, CBOR, and MessagePack data.
It supports wildcards, recursive descent, array slicing, filter expressions,
and regex matching.
en-US.name: jsongrep
